scripts.format: npm run format:go && npm run format:kotlin && npm run format:client
scripts.format:check: npm run format:go:check && npm run format:kotlin:check && npm run format:client:check
scripts.format:go: (cd ws && find . -type d \( -name generated -o -name vendor \) -prune -o -type f -name "*.go" -exec go tool goimports -w -local messenger/ws,messenger/tests/load/ws {} +) && (cd tests/load/ws && find . -type d \( -name generated -o -name vendor \) -prune -o -type f -name "*.go" -exec go tool goimports -w -local messenger/ws,messenger/tests/load/ws {} +)
scripts.format:go:check: bash -o pipefail -c '(cd ws && find . -type d \( -name generated -o -name vendor \) -prune -o -type f -name "*.go" -exec go tool goimports -l -local messenger/ws,messenger/tests/load/ws {} + | diff -u /dev/null -) && (cd tests/load/ws && find . -type d \( -name generated -o -name vendor \) -prune -o -type f -name "*.go" -exec go tool goimports -l -local messenger/ws,messenger/tests/load/ws {} + | diff -u /dev/null -)'
scripts.audit:dependencies: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix contracts audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --audit-level=high && go -C ws run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.8.0 ./... && npm run audit:kotlin
